Made from natural resins, essential oils, and herbal blends, these incense sticks offer a calming fragrance experience that supports mental clarity, emotional balance, and daily well-being. Perfect for those who value purity and peaceful living.
benefits: Crafted with 100% natural sandalwood paste and essential oils
Charcoal-free formulation results in non-toxic, cleaner smoke
Burn time of 40-45 minutes with a scent that lingers for hours
Includes a handmade ceramic holder in every pack

specifications.Ingredients: Natural Sandalwood powder, resins, natural gums, essential oils

applications: Place a dhoop stick securely in the provided ceramic holder.
Light the tip until it catches flame, then gently blow it out to leave a glowing ember.
Keep away from drafty areas, children, and flammable materials.

faqs.question: Is this dhoop safe for indoor use?
faqs.answer: Yes, our dhoop sticks are charcoal-free and organic, meaning they produce zero harmful black carbon smoke and are safe for indoor ventilation.

Ideal for spiritual rituals, meditation, or simply unwinding after a long day.
benefits: Made with dried jasmine flower powder and natural gums
Zero added synthetic colors or artificial fragrance enhancers
Helps elevate mood, reduce anxiety, and clear negative energies
Environmentally friendly packaging

specifications.Ingredients: Jasmine flower powder, natural resins, honey, wood powder

Place in a ventilated area to fill the room with sweet, natural jasmine fragrance.

faqs.question: Does it leave a lot of ash?

name: CEZLIAR Pro Drain Opener
description: An industrial-grade, ultra-powerful drain cleaning solution designed to dissolve hair, grease, soap scum, and organic blockages in minutes. Safe for all piping systems and septic tanks.
benefits: Fast-acting formula clears heavy blockages in under 15 minutes
Dissolves hair, grease, food waste, and toilet paper effortlessly
Safe for PVC, copper, steel, iron, and septic system designs
Contains built-in odor neutralizers to eliminate foul sink smells
applications: Pour 250ml of Pro Drain Opener directly into the clogged drain.
Let it sit for 15-20 minutes (for heavy clogs, leave for 30 minutes).
Flush thoroughly with plenty of hot water.

faqs.question: Can I use this in my toilet?
faqs.answer: Yes, but for toilets we recommend letting it sit for 30 minutes before flushing, as the water volume dilutes the product.

faqs.question: Will it damage plastic pipes?
faqs.answer: No. Our formulation is specifically engineered to be safe on all PVC, copper, and iron plumbing.

name: Advanced Aqua Filter System
description: A state-of-the-art multi-stage home water filtration system that combines sediment pre-filters, activated carbon blocks, and ultra-filtration membranes to deliver pure, crisp, and alkaline drinking water.
benefits: 9-stage filtration removes 99.9% of chlorine, heavy metals, and micro-particles
Under-sink compact layout saves valuable kitchen counter space
Re-mineralization cartridge restores essential calcium and magnesium ions
Includes a premium lead-free solid brass designer faucet
applications: Install under the kitchen sink connected to the cold water supply line.
Mount the dedicated premium tap on the sink counter.
Replace filter cartridges easily once a year with the twist-and-lock mechanism.

faqs.question: Do I need professional installation?
faqs.answer: The system comes with a complete DIY installation kit and step-by-step video guide. Most users install it themselves in under 45 minutes.

faqs.question: Does this system waste water like RO filters?
faqs.answer: No, this is an advanced UF + Carbon system which produces zero wastewater, making it eco-friendly and efficient.

name: White oudh Solid Perfume Balm 19.18g
description: Indulge in the rich, majestic aura of CEZLIAR White Oudh Solid Perfume. Crafted with a premium wax base and natural essential oils, this alcohol-free perfume balm delivers a warm, balsamic oud scent that lingers beautifully on the skin. Elegant, travel-friendly, and perfect for quick touch-ups.
benefits: Convenient travel-friendly pocket tin
Alcohol-free, beeswax-based luxury balm
Rich and warm oriental woody aroma
Gentle on skin and long-lasting formulation
applications: Swirl your finger over the perfume balm to warm it up.
Apply directly to pulse points like wrists, neck, and behind the ears.
Reapply throughout the day as desired for a fresh burst of fragrance.

faqs.question: How long does a solid perfume last on skin?
faqs.answer: Since solid perfumes are oil and wax-based, they evaporate slowly and typically last between 4 to 6 hours on skin.

name: CEZLIAR Premium PP Spun Filter 5 Micron
description: Protect your family and your water filtration system with the CEZLIAR Premium PP Spun Filter. Made with 100% pure food-grade polypropylene, this 5-micron sediment filter efficiently removes dirt, sand, rust, and suspended particles, ensuring clean water and extending the life of your RO membranes.
benefits: High-dirt holding capacity for cleaner water
Made with food-grade 100% pure polypropylene
Efficient 5-micron filtration rating
Compatible with all standard 10-inch filter housings
applications: Turn off the water supply to the filter housing.
Unscrew the housing cover using a spanner.
Remove the old filter and insert the new CEZLIAR PP Spun filter.
Screw the housing back tightly and turn on the water supply.

faqs.question: How often should I replace the PP spun filter?
faqs.answer: We recommend replacing the filter every 3 to 6 months, or sooner if you notice a drop in water pressure or significant discoloration.

name: CEZLIAR Activated Carbon Block Filter Candle
description: Experience crisp, clean water with the CEZLIAR Activated Carbon Block Filter Candle. Sourced from high-density coconut shell activated carbon, this candle removes chlorine, organic compounds, bad odor, and taste, delivering healthy and sweet tasting drinking water.
benefits: Premium coconut shell carbon for superior absorption
Effectively removes chlorine, bad taste, and odors
Protects RO membrane from chemical damage
Long operational life with high flow rate
applications: Turn off the RO system and close the water supply.
Remove the carbon filter stage cartridge from its holder.
Install the new CEZLIAR carbon block candle securely.
Flush the new filter for 5 minutes before connecting it to the RO membrane.

faqs.question: Does this filter remove TDS?
faqs.answer: No, carbon block filters are designed to remove chlorine, chemicals, odor, and organic impurities, not dissolved salts (TDS). TDS reduction is handled by the RO membrane.

name: CEZLIAR Complete RO Pre-Filter Outer Housing Set
description: A comprehensive pre-filtration solution for your home RO system. The CEZLIAR Complete Pre-Filter Set includes a heavy-duty outer filter housing, a premium 5-micron PP spun filter, teflon tape, and all necessary connectors to ensure a leak-proof pre-filtration setup.
benefits: Heavy-duty leak-proof pre-filter housing
Comes with premium connectors and Teflon tape
Protects inline filters from heavy mud and rust
Universal compatibility with all household RO systems

specifications.Compatibility: Works with Kent, Aquaguard, Livpure, etc.
specifications.Set Includes: Housing, PP Spun Filter, Spanner, Elbows, Teflon Tape

applications: Mount the pre-filter housing bracket on the wall near the water source.
Insert the PP spun filter inside the housing.
Connect the inlet pipe to the inlet port and outlet pipe to the RO system inlet.
Tighten securely with the provided spanner and check for leaks.

faqs.question: Does this set include the filter inside?
faqs.answer: Yes, this set comes complete with one 10-inch PP Spun filter candle inside, plus all elbows and teflon tape.

name: CEZLIAR RO Water Pipe Tube & Connector Kit
description: A premium quality accessory kit for installing and maintaining your water purifier. Features a 10-meter food-grade 1/4 inch PE water pipe tube, along with a collection of quick push-fit elbow and straight connectors to ensure a clean, reliable, and leak-free installation.
benefits: 10-meter food-grade high pressure flexible PE tube
Includes leak-proof quick-fit connectors
Durable material resistant to cracks and aging
Easy DIY push-fit installation
applications: Cut the PE tube to the desired length with a sharp cutter.
Push the tube firmly into the quick-fit connector until it locks in place.
Use the lock clips to secure the connector joint.
To disconnect, press the collar of the connector and pull the tube out.

faqs.question: Is this pipe compatible with all RO purifiers?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 1/4 inch tube is the standard size used for water inlet, outlet, and reject lines in almost all domestic RO and UV purifiers.
